results.title: 「TIGER & BUNNY」THE STAGE
results.overview: Stage adaptation of the 2011 anime. "TIGER & BUNNY," which depicts the exploits of heroes bearing the logos of real companies, aired in 2011. This is an original animated series that gained explosive popularity. Theatrical releases followed in 2012 and 2014, and in 2022, the highly anticipated sequel, "TIGER & BUNNY 2," was released worldwide, dominating trends. And now, as they reach their 15th anniversary year, they take to the stage— A talented staff and a diverse cast present this to all the citizens of Sternbild.

results.title: The Light
results.overview: Ninth, longest and final part of the cycle “Thou Art BENEDICTUS”. Chaotic abstraction, an escape from the unknown. An allusion to the light that moves from place to place at infinite speed, in an unknown, random direction. Is it in fact… escaping too?

results.title: The Green
results.overview: Eighth part of the cycle “Thou Art BENEDICTUS”. Trees, Shrubs, Bushes, Leaves, Flowers - everything that is Green, and not only.

results.title: The Wind
results.overview: Seventh part of the cycle “Thou Art BENEDICTUS”. The wind gently rustles through the aluminum... through itself.

results.title: The Clouds (canon)
results.overview: Sixth part of the cycle “Thou Art BENEDICTUS”. Triple visual canon with rushing colorful clouds as their subjects.

results.title: The Sand
results.overview: Fifth part of the cycle “Thou Art BENEDICTUS”. Reflections on the sand - taken literally and metaphorically.

results.title: The Circle
results.overview: Fourth part of the cycle “Thou Art BENEDICTUS”. A caleidoscopic depiction of world spinning in a circle.

results.title: The Fire
results.overview: Third part of the cycle “Thou Art BENEDICTUS”. A group of candles and the fire are put into constant visual transformations.

results.title: The Water
results.overview: Second part of “Thou Art BENEDICTUS”. A calm meditation on endless visual and philosophical possibilities of the water.

results.title: Thou Art BENEDICTUS
results.overview: “Thou Art BENEDICTUS” is the first part of a cycle of the same title. The entire cycle focuses on concepts related to nature, concepts that are “saintly”—hence, “BENEDICTUS”. In “Thou Art BENEDICTUS,” shots related to nature (a lake from different points of view) and travel (a train) are used. Its form almost resembles a theme and variations. It is divided into five sections where its basic material is repeated 5 times; each time, new layers of shots are incorporated to what has been used before.

results.title: Thou Art BENEDICTUS - a symphony of film
results.original_title: Thou Art BENEDICTUS - a symphony of film
results.overview: Integral version of "Thou Art BENEDICTUS" - a "symphony" of nine silent short films: "Thou Art BENEDICTUS", "The Water", "The Fire", "The Circle", "The Sand", "The Clouds (canon)", "The Wind", "The Green" and "The Light". Part twelve of the cycle "The Requiem Films".

results.title: Happy Glasses
results.overview: Happy Glasses are a new product that promise to end depression by making the user only see the bright side of life. However, two siblings find that such promises always come with a price.

results.title: Heads and Tails
results.overview: A new stage, a workshop, queens—and a king. A photo booth session before impressing the judges at the De Luxe Talent Show. The "Chanelazo" is here. Supremme de Luxe confirms that the lip-syncs remain do-or-die, high-stakes showdowns.

results.title: Pekopon Invasion Musical "Keroro Gunsō"
results.original_title: ペコポン侵略ミュージカル『ケロロ軍曹』
results.overview: Sergeant Keroro spends his days lazing about, completely neglecting the invasion plans. Amidst this, Tamama begins to miss his home planet, Keron, so intensely that he develops Keron-sick Syndrome. To remedy this, the Keroro Platoon and the Hinata siblings venture into the Mock Planet Keron—a virtual space created by "KI," an AI currently under development by Kururu! While the group initially enjoys their time in this "Mock Planet Keron", the AI ​​undergoes an unexpected evolution of its own, creating the "Meta-Keroro Platoon—replicas of Keroro and his team, but perfect and flawless! The "flawless" Meta-Keroro Platoon stands in their way, stopping them from returning to the real world.
